subject: Request: Customer references + timeline constraints — cadence & substitute options
messages:
From: Elliot Price <elliot.price@oaktree.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-01 09:17 PDT
Subject: Quick request — 2 refs + short case study for execs

Hi Olga,

We’re finalizing our evaluation deck for the board next week and would like to include two customer references (ideally: one ML infra-focused, one product/UX-focused) and a 1‑page case study or testimonial. Can you share availability for short intro calls (15-20m) this week or next?

Also, if customers prefer not to speak, would a short written testimonial be acceptable? We can accept a one-paragraph quote.

Thanks — Elliot
Elliot Price
Head of Product, OakTree AI
elliot.price@oaktree.ai
(415) 555-0142

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@oaktree.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-01 11:03 PDT
Subject: Re: Quick request — 2 refs + short case study for execs

Hi Elliot — thanks for the note and congrats on getting the board deck together. We can help, but two quick context items so I set expectations: 1) We rotate references to avoid fatigue and respect customer bandwidth; 2) We require consent for any published quotes / case studies.

Options we can offer immediately:
- Fast path (written quote only): we can surface 2 opt-in written quotes within 3 business days if customers agree.
- Call path (15-20m): we can surface 1 available call in 5 business days and a second call within 10 business days, depending on their schedules.
- Substitute path: if a requested customer declines, we’ll propose up to 3 substitute contacts with similar profile.

I’ve attached our internal reference rotation guide and a consent template — feel free to share the template with your legal team if you plan to publish. If you can confirm which vertical (infra vs product) you prefer for each slot and whether written-only is acceptable, I’ll route to customers.

Best,
Olga
Senior Sales Director, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Attachments: reference-rotation-guide.pdf, reference-consent-template.docx

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-10-02 08:22 PDT
Subject: FW: Quick request — 2 refs + short case study for execs

Olga — forwarding because this looks like a short-cycle deal and OakTree is a strategic prospect for our infra messaging. A couple notes from CS/Customer Ops side:

- We’ve seen reference fatigue with this customer segment; prefer to offer a written quote first to avoid over-soliciting.
- If they insist on calls, let’s prioritize customers who have ~1 month of no recent reference activity. I can check the reference cadence logs and suggest two names.

Laura — can you pull the last-ref date for the infra/ML infra customers list and flag ones with no outreach in the last 30 days?

Ben
Director, Sales Engineering

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-02 10:41 PDT
Subject: Re: FW: Quick request — 2 refs + short case study for execs

On Oct 2, 2026, 08:22, Ben Carter wrote: > Laura — can you pull the last-ref date...

Done. I ran the list this morning. Two potential callable refs that meet our rotation rules:

1) Priya Menon, Head of ML Ops, Acme Retail (last contacted for ref: 2026-08-05) — open to a written quote or 15-min intro next week (her assistant prefers Tue/Thu mornings).
2) Marcus Lin, VP Platform, DataStream (last contacted: 2026-07-10) — prefers written quotes; calls only if scheduled 2+ weeks out.

Given OakTree’s ask (infra + product), I recommend: offer Priya for the infra slot as a call option and Marcus for the written quote/product testimonial. If Priya declines to speak, we’ll provide two substitutes: Sofia Ivanova and Diego Fernandez (both have relevant use cases).

I’ll prepare the consent template and send to Priya’s assistant if you approve.

Laura
Customer Success Operations

Olga — please proceed with Priya as the call candidate and Marcus for the written quote. If Priya can’t do 10/06 AM PT, use your substitute list.

Elliot

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@oaktree.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Priya Menon <priya.menon@acmeinc.com>

Hi all — quick update and plan:

1) Priya’s assistant confirmed a 15-min introductory call on Tue 2026-10-06 at 9:15 AM PT. I booked the slot and shared a tentative agenda (15m: 5m intro, 8m use-case + outcomes, 2m next steps). Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=oak-ref-call

2) Marcus agreed to provide a 1-paragraph written testimonial by 2026-10-08. I attached the consent template to his assistant and asked for publication permission tied to the quote.

3) Substitutes: if Priya needs to reschedule, we’ll propose Sofia Ivanova and Diego Fernandez. Per our rotation policy, we’ll only ask each substitute for a written quote unless they explicitly offer time for a call.

4) Attachment: I’ve attached the short Reference Rotation Guide to show OakTree our cadence policy. If the board needs the case study published quickly, please note publication can take 2–3 business days after consent is returned.

Next steps for Elliot: confirm the agenda and whether you’d like an anonymized quote for slides or full attribution.

Thanks — Olga
Senior Sales Director, Redwood Inference
